text_block_list.text: The final day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm just glad we made it through 
training camp safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once back at the academy, the research 
environment is properly equipped. It seems 
I can finally be of use.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A new drink? I have high hopes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It might not necessarily be a drink, but 
we'll use trial and error. To find the 
method for breaking limits that suits you 
best.

Breaking through the limits—the challenge 
for the "Sprinters Stakes." It made itself 
apparent during the summer training 
camp...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... What's my time?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ghk...!

Calstone Light O's progress had stalled. 
After the Ibis SD, her times plateaued. 
They weren't dropping, but they weren't 
improving either.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Seeing as you don't ask why, it 
seems you've realized it as well, Right 
O-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How about it, Right O-kun?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"My body won't move like it did during the 
Ibis Summer Dash. However, it isn't 
fatigue. My condition is the same as in 
regular training."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's likely because the environment is 
different from a race. There are no 
cheering spectators, no rivals to compete 
against.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, even before that... current me 
hasn't surpassed the me from before the 
Ibis SD.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's no different from before. Exactly the 
same. Has her growth stalled...?
choice_data_list: I think we've probably hit the limit...

text_block_list.text:
"The Ibis Summer Dash was the best run 
currently possible for her."

I thoroughly refined everything from my 
conditioning to my form, and trained 
relentlessly to boost my fundamental 
strength. Right now is my absolute best, 
and also my speed's limit.

"Once you reach this level, developing 
your abilities suddenly becomes difficult. 
That's because you've already pushed your 
power to its absolute limits."

From this point forward, our progress will 
be mind-numbingly slow.

Spending months conditioning and training 
your body just to shave off a mere 0.01 
seconds... That's the level we're talking 
about.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is not as though you are 
incapable of growth. In that case, let us 
continue.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Wait. You're forgetting something 
important.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Light O-chan's body is at its 
limit. No matter how slight it may seem, 
any further training would push her past 
the breaking point.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...The risk of injury becomes extremely 
high.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"It is true that pushing past one's limits 
can raise the threshold itself. However, 
that is a double-edged sword."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
There are Umamusume who wished desperately 
to run faster, only to suffer injuries in 
the end... and leave the turf forever.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I need to think this through carefully. 
Once done, there will be no turning back 
from any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A double-edged sword...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
High-intensity training is inherently 
perilous. Whether flesh and blood or 
machine, exceed the limit and it will 
break. It is simply natural law.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you wish for more than you deserve, you 
might end up like me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Backing down from the challenge is not an 
option.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I will continue to pursue maximum speed. 
By any means necessary."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Push past my limits? Bring it on. If 
that's what it takes to reach a speed no 
one else can touch!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: There's no problem, right, Trainer?

With unwavering eyes, Calstone Light O 
stared straight at me.

Firm in the conviction that there was no 
other answer than yes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think the Trainer would take the 
risk?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because I made a promise.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: To aim for the speed I desire!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I want to become even faster. 
Fast enough to surpass even a cheetah's 
top speed.
"Aim for that speed!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I see. My assessment aligns with 
yours. Your trainer had been making 
preparations with that very intention.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I took my time and carefully reinforced 
the chassis so we could fit a bigger 
engine in it!
choice_data_list:
There's no such thing as absolute safety, 
but...

text_block_list.text:
I've focused on conditioning and body 
maintenance so she can withstand speeds 
beyond the limit. I've also observed her 
closely to catch even the slightest 
change.
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure you don't overexert 
yourself.

I'll make sure you don't overexert 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"So there's no need to worry, Godolphin 
Barb."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right. That was how it 
was...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: And so, a new history will be woven...

...And so, we ended up attempting to break 
through her limits, but it hasn't led to 
any remarkable results yet.

Even if one attempts to surpass their 
limits, a plateau in growth is inevitable. 
Still... it is troublesome.

Amidst all this, today we were discussing 
a strategy against Durandal, our rival in 
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweeping in all at once from the back, 
it's Durandal! A brilliant late charge to 
the goooaaal!
choice_data_list: What an incredible finishing kick, huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It's the prized 'sharpness of the holy 
sword.' Or so Durandal claims."

"Regardless of what you call it, there's 
no doubt that a sharp late spurt is 
Durandal's greatest weapon."

She's a troublesome opponent for Calstone 
Light O. She'll challenge her at top speed 
in the final stretch, just as Light O 
begins to slow down.

Her distance aptitude is probably best at 
1000m. I have to say even 1200m would be 
pushing it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However... a way to conquer Durandal. I'm 
starting to get a faint idea.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It looks kind of like something...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see now! They resembled each other!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: To a cheetah!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Cheetahs lack endurance, you see. That is 
why they only sprint full-out right before 
capturing their prey.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal is the same. She only gets fast 
right before the finish line."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: In other words, Durandal is a cheetah!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's run with a cheetah in the Umulator! 
It will be great counter-training for 
Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, against a cheetah, no less.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It might actually be a surprisingly 
effective method, you know? If you want to 
run beyond your limits, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Pushing past your limits is 
surprisingly difficult, isn't it? As you 
can see from how Right O-kun is struggling 
with it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The brain and body activate a limiter. 
Even during high-load training, it 
subconciously controls you so your body 
doesn't break."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, there are circumstances where 
those limiters come off. What about when 
you must run, even if your body breaks?
choice_data_list: ...I see, when your life is on the line!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed. When a living creature faces 
mortal peril, its survival instincts kick 
in to escape death. At that moment, any 
hindering limiters are stripped away as 
well.”
choice_data_list:
However, isn't that a trick you can't use 
in a race?

Still, isn't that a trick you can't use in 
a race?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Did you forget? The placebo effect was 
incredibly effective on Daitaku Helios."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The cheetah is merely a device. All that 
matters is instilling a sense of crisis to 
trigger breaking through the limits.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I haven't the slightest idea 
what's going on! What am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just think of Durandal as a cheetah. 
That's all you need to know."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Durandal is a cheetah, 
Durandal is a cheetah, Durandal is a 
cheetah...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Debating hypotheses is the height of 
futility. Action speaks louder than 
words—let us test it out!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I've uploaded Durandal-chan's race data 
into the cheetah. This is what you wanted, 
right?
choice_data_list:
Light O, the plan is to go with Front 
Runner

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will definitely outrun that 
cheetah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, what is this pressure...! Is this a 
mortal threat...?! I have to run!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I won't let myself get caught! Move, legs! 
HAAAAAAAAAH!

Sensing the cheetah's presence, Calstone 
Light O regained her composure. Her 
deceleration came to a halt.

Because Calstone Light O poured everything 
she had into the start, her deceleration 
grew more pronounced toward the final 
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
She's maintaining her speed even in the 
final stretch today.

However, that was short-lived. My legs 
grew sluggish once more. I had hit the 
limits of my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Cheetah—no, Durandal! So this is 
your late-race surge!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (Sharp, indeed. And fast! But...!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna be faster than anyone! Faster 
than Durendal! Faster than a cheetah!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll run away with the lead!! Uwaaaaagh, 
haaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her breathing is ragged. Has her stored 
energy run out, rendering anaerobic 
exercise ineffective?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, her legs have not dulled. Even 
with her stamina exhausted, she still 
tries to accelerate.

Yes, Calstone Light O was holding on. She 
keeps running at a pace that maintains the 
distance!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—It seems you've surpassed them. Your 
physical limits, that is.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
That's the goal. ...I led from wire to 
wire.

Pushing beyond the limit, accelerating 
until the very end. That tenacity, however 
slight, was reflected in the race time.

"She can still get faster— Calstone Light 
O's potential is bottomless."
